name: The Meal — Epistemic Metabolism and the Shared Table
description: The authored movement: hunger made perceptible, the plate and its preparations, tasting and chewing, the container, the shared table, and satiety with renewed hunger.

scenes.name: Information without nourishment
scenes.character: The report can be recalled and repeated; the next morning the account of the world proceeds as before. The feed takes the place of seeking.

entities.name: the finished report — recallable, unchanged in its receiver
the continuous feed — attention occupied, the discrepancy unarticulated
the display case — cataloguing behind glass, untouched
the disposal — distinctions destroyed before consequence
appetite — the question with standing as an opening

text.kicker: #0 · the authored video-essay outline; the quilt's logos-health appointment (human-amplified: yes)
text.title: Information without nourishment
text.italic: The opening images demonstrate what the meal requires: a passage through received difference — the feed's interruptions keep attention occupied while the quieter discrepancy stays unarticulated.

text.body: The reader has finished the report: its contents can be recalled, repeated and discussed; next morning the world proceeds as before — something received without entering the conditions from which the reader judges and acts. Food has arrived, but the meal has not taken place. A stream of supplied answers arrives so continuously that the recipient has little opportunity to feel a question; the feed takes the place of seeking.

interruptions keep attention occupied while the quieter discrepancy stays unarticulated — what is encountered and what the inherited account allows no longer fit together. Appetite gives that discrepancy a direction: what needs understanding, what has resisted explanation, what would count as an answer — felt urgency without a certified conclusion. Two failure images: the display case preserves material behind glass, catalogued untouched; the disposal destroys distinctions before they become consequential.
Occurrences: the finished report (#0); the feed (#0, returned at #5→0's emptied rite); the display case and disposal (#0); the standing question (#0, #1).

scenes.name: The plate and its five preparations
scenes.character: Raw, cooked, heavily processed, junk, fermented — roles in an authored information ecology, with provenance from the first contact.

entities.name: raw — the demanding texture of primary material
cooked — responsible interpretation making material accessible
processed — earlier transformations hard to recover
junk — stimulation after the relation to nourishment has fallen away
fermented — inherited practices having worked on what a newcomer receives
provenance — who produced it, what it says, what preparation it carries

text.kicker: #1 · the outline's five forms; A29 delegated labour
text.title: The plate and its five preparations
text.italic: Preparation embodies an affirmative office: another's labour can make an encounter possible — the question is whether it stays answerable to what was prepared.

text.body: The plate gives the question something determinate to meet: a document, an account, a testimony, an argument. Provenance matters from contact — who produced the material, what it says, what work prepared it; document-existence and inferred truth are different matters. Preparation has five forms: raw carries the demanding texture of primary material; cooked figures responsible interpretation; processed, transformations hard to recover; junk, stimulation after nourishment has fallen away.

fermentation figures inherited practices earlier participants worked on — roles in an authored information ecology, not a dietary ranking. Cooking's affirmative office: a good translation opens the source, if it remains answerable to what was prepared and leaves the recipient able to examine, disagree and continue. A29 follows what happens when the finished product is accepted but the conditions and costs of its production disappear from the account.
Occurrences: the five preparation roles (#1); the provenance questions (#1, #5→0's circuit); the disappeared labour (#1, returned at #4).

scenes.name: Taste and chewing
scenes.character: Attraction and aversion at the threshold; the fourfold discrimination; contact discharged before its work — the pathologies of consumption mistaken for nourishment.

entities.name: the first taste — welcome or rejection before the material is worked through
chewing — distinguishing statement from evidence, event from interpretation
the fourfold — affirm · reject · hold together · recognise a false alternative
the pathology — the jolt discharged before the work; gulping; refusal; the sensation of consumption mistaken for nourishment

text.kicker: #2 · the outline's thresholds and pathologies; the taste/knowing word-field as research route
text.title: Taste and chewing
text.italic: The mouth demonstrates discrimination maintaining contact with what it distinguishes — the relation does not wait for an etymology to license it, nor verify one in return.

text.body: The first bite has a taste: attraction, aversion and neutrality at the threshold — a familiar account welcome, a contrary one provoking rejection. Liking an account and establishing its claim do different work. Chewing prolongs contact: the epistemic act follows the texture of a claim — statement from evidence, event from interpretation, connection from the explanation offered; returning to the passage instead of letting the headline decide.

The fourfold keeps several responses available: affirm what is established; reject what the evidence contradicts; hold together jointly present aspects; recognise when the proposed alternatives fail to address the material — the fourth can change the question under which the plate was first presented. The pathology is contact repeatedly discharged before its work: mistaking the sensation of consumption for nourishment. The taste/knowing word-fields remain research routes.
Occurrences: the first taste's valuations (#2); the fourfold discrimination (#2); the discharged contact (#2); the word-field routes (#2, held at #5→0).

scenes.name: The container; the shared table; companions are not food
scenes.character: The stomach's bounded interior; criteria changing; the epistemic microbiome; A30's reciprocal world-constitution; the devouring table refused.

entities.name: the container — a bounded interior able to sustain the work it permits
the changed criteria — a decisive distinction become incidental; an excluded condition become necessary
the shared table — companions from histories the others do not possess
the epistemic microbiome — inherited frameworks and practices assisting beyond solitary agency
companions are not food — the contributor retains the capacity to contest use (A29/A30)

text.kicker: #3–#4 · Symbolon Dynamics' native mechanism; A30; the Apportionment and Encounter/Countenance fields
text.title: The container; the shared table; companions are not food
text.italic: The table demonstrates reciprocal world-constitution: one participant's contribution becomes a condition of another's action without making its source mere material — assimilation reaches the receiving organisation itself.

text.body: What has been chewed passes where its first form can loosen: the stomach figures a bounded interior able to sustain the work it permits. The initial story can be taken apart for another account; more than changing the conclusion, change the criteria through which the next conclusion is reached — Symbolon Dynamics' image, interpreter and altered field. Patience means allowing the work time; no rule makes distress evidence of truth.

The table receives companions whose contributions change what the others can next ask; disagreement is included — a correction to a passage differs from a change in who can speak. The microbiome image names inherited frameworks assisting beyond solitary agency, biological claims kept to their own sources. Companions are not food: a table absorbing everyone's work into one authority performs the devouring relation the meal exists to transform.

Occurrences: the criteria changed in processing (#3); the disagreeing table (#4); the microbiome image (#4); the non-food boundary (#4, against the black sun's capture in the taylor-images whole's field).

scenes.name: Satiety, rest, renewed hunger — and the emptied rite
scenes.character: Enough worked through to act from changed ground; rest without compulsory intake; hunger beginning from changed ground; the sacramental coda with its own historical limits.

entities.name: satiety — nourishment recognisable in the change of capacity
rest — the meal can be enough; no machinery of compulsory intake
renewed hunger — beginning from changed ground, unlike the uninterrupted demand
the coda — bread in the hands of companions; loaves and fishes as the outline's explicit wink, no derivation of 4+2
the emptied rite — form continuing after the capacity to change relation has ceased

text.kicker: #5→0 · logos-health; the Symbol/Account/Trust and Arbitration fields; A29/A30/A35; A21
text.title: Satiety, rest, renewed hunger — and the emptied rite
text.italic: The meal returns-to its arguments with the whole movement intact: received determination examined, assimilated, shared and returned so the receiver and the conditions of future receiving can change.

text.body: The meal can finish. Satiety gives a measure of sufficiency: enough worked through to judge, act or live from changed ground. Integration increases the ability to bear differentiated relations; recognition makes source and history active; repeating a transformation's vocabulary leaves the identifying act untouched. Then a new question arises from the nourished life — renewed hunger carries the previous meal's consequence, unlike the uninterrupted demand for the next stimulus.

The coda places bread in the hands of companions, naming potlatch, seder, langar, iftar and thanksgiving — the association remaining the outline's explicit wink, no derivation of 4+2. The coda retains the emptied rite: the meal's form continuing after its capacity to bring people into changed relation has ceased. Logos-health names the integrity (human-amplified: yes for the ratified operation); demonstrating a therapeutic or institutional outcome would be another task.
Occurrences: the satiety and rest (#5→0); the renewed hunger against the feed (#0, #5→0); the emptied rite (#5→0); the declared returns to A29/A30/A35 (#4, #5→0).
